{"id":1865268678,"question_id":4130,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"6 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1766689344,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1865268678/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Maximum Score After Binary Swaps","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    long long maximumScore(vector<int>& nums, string s) {\n        priority_queue<long long>pq;\n        long long ans = 0;\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<nums.size() ; i++) ans += s[i] == '1' ? nums[i] : 0;\n\n        long long sum = 0;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<nums.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            if(s[i] == '1') \n            {\n                if(!pq.empty())\n                {\n                    sum += pq.top();  pq.pop();\n                }\n                else sum += 0;\n            }\n            pq.push(nums[i]);\n        }\n        return max(sum , ans);\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"maximum-score-after-binary-swaps","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1401}
